audit.why: Early is Orianna's (ball poke/clear at range, Q down to 3s max rank); Malzahar wins 6 and first-item isolated 1v1s via point-click suppression on a dashless target; teamfights swing back to Shockwave. Content layer says this; full-layer chart lagged.
Spikes: Ori 3-5, Malz 6 and 1st item, Ori late in grouped fights. All 4 spikes[] present and consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content named Command: Dissonance as her E — Dissonance is W, Protect is E — and 'Q-E poke' appears in whys[1]/wants.foe[0]. Missing interaction: Command: Protect's shield (9s CD) absorbs the Q-W-E burst window and must be forced before committing. 'Iron Boundary' fabricated passive name; no cooldown digits in breakdown.cooldowns. Packet defect: zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Kit file: Ori Q 7/6/5/4/3, W 7, E 9 (shield + resists), R 110/95/80; Malz Q 6s silence, R 140/110/80. Ori has no dash — Nether Grasp is unanswerable 1v1.
audit.corrected: Slots fixed, shield-force sequencing added to trades and cooldowns, real numbers added.
